name: Registered Apprenticeship at Edison Academy
org: Fairfax County Public Schools - Edison Academy
note: Re-verified against Edison Academy's own course page on 2026-09-08. Confirmed as a paid registered apprenticeship in the skilled trades, open to students already in the matching CTE course sequence.

offerings.summary: Fairfax students who have finished a level 1 CTE course in auto technology, construction, electrical or HVAC-R work for a sponsoring employer at a competitive wage while continuing classroom instruction at Edison Academy.

loc.venue: Edison Academy and sponsoring employer worksites

age.raw: Must be 16 years old before beginning work experience

school.raw: Must have successfully completed a level 1 CTE high school course in the same course sequence

other: Must have successfully completed a level 1 CTE high school course in the same course sequence
Must secure the work experience with sponsored apprenticeship employer by October but preferably prior to the school year start date
Students must complete training agreements before the experience begins

sched.dur_raw: A minimum of 280 On the Job Training/work hours to receive 1 course credit
sched.hours_raw: An average of 20 hours earned per year...for a minimum of 2,000 hours

app.instructions: Register through the Edison Academy CTE course sequence and secure a sponsoring employer.

deadlines.raw: Must secure the work experience with sponsored apprenticeship employer by October but preferably prior to the school year start date

issues: The page states an age floor and a CTE prerequisite but no grade levels.

evidence.quote: Must be 16 years old before beginning work experience
A minimum of 144 hours of Related Technical Instruction in the high school CTE classroom ... A minimum of 280 On the Job Training/work hours to receive 1 course credit ... Earn a Competitive Wage
Must have successfully completed a level 1 CTE high school course in the same course sequence ... a 2.5 cumulative GPA
